templates.why_chosen: Panel (a)'s 7-component schematic (QPU array through bus and queue to shared QRAM) is paired with panel (b)'s Big-O table, the schematic-plus-cost-table two-panel variant, at high confidence with only 3 flows.
templates.what_to_learn: Use a metrics table, not a second schematic, as panel (b) when the comparison is quantitative: rows are the metrics, columns are the two designs, and Big-O terms substitute for exact numbers.
